request:
镜头 s25：纪录片中引用的旧资料影像，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：资料影像，新闻摄像机长焦，缓慢推近那枚红色镜头。巨大的黑色终端墙中央，红色镜头第一次亮起来，大厅里一排排人仰头看着。扬声器里传出平静的合成声音。环境声：大厅的回声、人群屏住呼吸。
情绪：solemn, awed, ominous
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：wide shot on a long news lens, one slow push in toward the red lens
景深与虚实：Long-lens compression; the people in the foreground soft, the lens sharp and glowing.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival 2058 broadcast footage of a solemn handover in a vast hall: rows of officials and engineers stand facing a colossal black terminal wall whose single huge round lens is glowing red for the first time; cold white light, reflections on the polished floor. Blocking lock: the colossal black terminal wall fills the background with the red lens at frame centre; rows of people stand with their backs to camera in the foreground.
Picture 2: MOSS terminal (black AI terminal with one red glowing lens) (character reference; role: the central AI's physical presence). Close view of an artificial-intelligence monitoring terminal built into a brushed-steel wall panel of a control hall: a black glass housing with a single round camera lens glowing deep red in its centre, a thin ring of red light around it, faint reflections of people in the glass. Cold, clinical, perfectly clean in contrast with the worn surroundings.
Picture 3: the 2058 handover hall of the global network authority (location reference; role: location reference). A vast, solemn control hall of the 2058 global network authority: tiered empty rows facing a colossal black monolithic terminal wall with a single huge round red-glowing lens at its centre, in the design of the reference terminal; cold white light, a polished floor reflecting the red lens. Empty of people.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. MOSS (calm, polite, emotionless synthetic male voice coming from a loudspeaker) — MOSS（平静、礼貌、没有情绪的合成男声，从扬声器传出）: 我是MOSS。从现在起，由我统一调度。
现场环境声：hall echo, the hush of a large crowd holding its breath, a faint electrical hum
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 10.0s, 24fps, archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, wide shot on a long news lens, shoulder-mounted ENG camera held from the back of the hall with one very slow, slightly unsteady push in from wide shot to medium-wide, the long-lens compression flattening the rows of heads against the wall; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. The colossal black terminal wall with its dead round lens sits at frame centre in the background; rows of officials and engineers stand with their backs to camera filling the lower foreground from frame left to frame right; polished floor glints in the band below them. Start: the hall is lit cold and flat, the round lens at frame centre is a dull dark circle, the crowd stands still and square-shouldered, a few heads turning slightly. Middle: the circle ignites — a deep red glow swells up from the centre of the lens, spills into a thin bright ring around it, smears and blooms across the tape as the whites clip, and the red reflection stretches down the polished floor; along the foreground rows heads tilt back one after another, shoulders settling, a hand raised to shade eyes. End: the camera has crept closer, the red lens now large and burning at frame centre, the nearest heads soft dark shapes along the bottom edge, the whole hall held still and silent under the glow. Mood: solemn, awed, ominous. Blur: the foreground heads and shoulders fall soft and out of focus, the red lens and the black wall stay sharp and glowing, the far ceiling dissolving into murky noise. MOSS (calm, polite, emotionless synthetic male voice coming from a loudspeaker) says, <d>[Chinese] 我是MOSS。从现在起，由我统一调度。</d>; Final line of this shot: end on "由我统一调度。", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Deep hall echo, the hush of a large crowd holding its breath, cloth shifting as heads tilt back, a faint electrical hum rising as the lens ignites, distant ventilation rumble, the loudspeaker crackling before the voice; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
